items.title: Apple (AAPL) Draws New £2 Billion UK ATT Lawsuit With Wider Europe Stakes
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) faces a new £2b lawsuit in the UK alleging its App Tracking Transparency feature favors its own advertising operations. The collective action claims ATT gives Apple an unfair advantage over third-party app developers and advertisers. The case adds to ongoing regulatory scrutiny of Apple’s App Store and privacy practices across Europe. This lawsuit highlights how Apple is only one part of a wider group of large tech and platform stocks that are tightly linked to data,...
